adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on failed `safeParse` but is never reset on success (`onSuccess` resets `multiEmailValue` and closes dialog, but doesn’t call `setIsInvalidEmail(false)`). Since the dialog component is always mounted in `BookingListItem.tsx` and closing via `onOpenChange` doesn’t reset the flag, the error banner can persist and show on subsequent opens or even after a successful add. Also, `handleAdd` returns early when `multiEmailValue.length === 0` (possible after removing all rows in `MultiEmail`), providing no user feedback, matching the finding.
